description_en: Updates the settings of a flow log
description_zh: 编辑流日志的名称和描述
kebab_example: aliyun smartag modify-flow-log-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --flow-log-id fl-7a56mar1kfw9vj0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyFlowLogAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the flow log is deployed
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The description of the flow log
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The name of the flow log
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The interval at which log data of active network connections is collected. Default value: 300. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 活跃流输出间隔，默认值为300s
parameters.name: active_aging

parameters.help_en: The interval at which log data of inactive network connections is collected. Default value: 15. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 非活跃流输出间隔，默认为15s
parameters.name: inactive_aging

parameters.help_en:
The location where the flow log is stored. Valid values:

sls: The flow log is stored in Log Service.

netflow: The flow log is stored on a NetFlow collector.

all: The flow log is stored both in Log Service and on a NetFlow collector
parameters.help_zh:
流日志输出类型：

sls：流日志存储在阿里云日志服务。

netflow：流日志存储在您配置的netflow服务器。

all：流日志同时存储在阿里云日志服务和您配置的netflow服务器
parameters.name: output_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where Log Service is deployed. This parameter is required when OutputType is set to sls
parameters.help_zh: 日志服务的地域ID，输出类型为sls时填入
parameters.name: sls_region_id

parameters.help_en: The project to which the Logstore of Log Service belongs. This parameter is required when OutputType is set to sls
parameters.help_zh: 日志服务的Project，输出类型为sls时填入
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The Logstore of Log Service. This parameter is required when OutputType is set to sls
parameters.help_zh: 日志服务的日志库，输出类型为sls时填入
parameters.name: logstore_name

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the NetFlow collector where the flow log is stored. This parameter is required when OutputType is set to netflow
parameters.help_zh: 流日志输出的服务器地址，输出类型为netflow时填入
parameters.name: netflow_server_ip

parameters.help_en: The port of the NetFlow collector. Default value: 9995. This parameter is required when OutputType is set to netflow
parameters.help_zh: 流日志输出的服务器端口，默认值为9995，输出类型为netflow时填入
parameters.name: netflow_server_port

parameters.help_en: The NetFlow version. Valid values: V5, V9, and V10. Default value: V9. This parameter is required when OutputType is set to netflow
parameters.help_zh: 流日志输出时使用的netflow协议版本号，可选V5、V9和V10，默认值V9，输出类型为netflow时填入
parameters.name: netflow_version

parameters.help_en: The ID of the flow log
parameters.name: flow_log_id
